mapIdentity.scope: Original museum 19-point shell and roof outline, separately mapped Courtyard House, Pharos, Round House, stair and ferry pier. The named site geometry is divided into roof, exposed front and river approach.

note: The riverfront photos show repeated grille fields framed by tapering rusty steel, a mostly concealed rear, glass and white plaster buildings above the terrace, and a stair down to the shore. The 17 m museum section is used only as scale evidence.
